for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-dovecot
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-dovecot
<iptables> -X f2b-dovecot

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-dovecot
done; done

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] dovecot: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The jail dovecot has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] dovecot: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The jail dovecot has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] dovecot: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against dovecot.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
destemail = a@b.c
maxretry = 2
banaction = iptables-allports
[pure-ftpd]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
maxretry =  3 
findtime = 1d
action = 
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=normal]
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
port = ssh
[dovecot]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
maxretry = x
bantime = %(findtime)s
action = %(action_mw)s
[mongodb-auth]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
maxretry = 1_0
action = hostsdeny
